model_output.verdict: Army maintenance and logistics leadership with measurable results, aimed at a civilian supervisor role.
write_up: A recruiter can see the move you're making: from Army maintenance and logistics leadership to a supply chain or operations supervisor role. The team, equipment and battalion responsibilities are concrete. The main question is how some of the military work translates to a civilian shop.

The vehicle readiness line is the model: it gives the starting rate, the finish and the two changes you made. The earlier mechanic role could say a little more about what you taught the junior mechanics.

cards.line: - Cut the unit's vehicle non-mission-capable rate from 18% to 6% in a year by changing the parts ordering process and the weekly maintenance schedule
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. You name the operational problem and show what you did about it, without making a recruiter guess which work was yours.

cards.question: What did you train the junior mechanics to do?
